item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 10/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a hot southerly airstream, the weather will be brighter apart from a few showers over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. With an active southwesterly airstream affecting the coastal areas in the latter part of this week, showers will increase with squally thunderstorms over the region.

Date/Month: 11/06 (Tuesday)
Wind: South to southwest force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny periods and a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms in the morning. Hot during the day.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
